# NIST PKITS test certificates

DER-encoded X.509 certificates from the NIST Public Key Infrastructure Test
Suite (PKITS), section 4.5 "Verifying Basic Self-Issued Certificates" — the CA
key rollover scenarios, in which self-issued certificates share a subject but
carry different public keys across CA key generations.

Source: https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/pki-testing
Copied from the pyca/cryptography test vectors:
https://github.com/pyca/cryptography/tree/main/vectors/cryptography_vectors/x509/PKITS_data/certs

PKITS is a work of the United States government and is in the public domain.
